author: Zephyr I
title: LN-gated ConvLSTM (64ch) + 1-head Attn with double-step recurrence (default PG)
abstract: Increase effective temporal computation by applying the same LayerNorm-gated ConvLSTM cell twice per env step (shared weights), keeping the CNN and attention pooling unchanged. Tests whether deeper recurrence helps planning under the fixed budget.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm_double_step import CNNConvLSTM_LN_DoubleStep
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNConvLSTM_LN_DoubleStep(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        attn_temp=1.0,
    )
